title: Faith Remains
paragraphs: “Ugh… T-This is a teleportation skill?”
“W-What the hell is this!?”

Father and Éclair both cried out in shock. Since Ren had already experienced it before, he wasn’t all that surprised. How about Itsuki? Judging by his expression, he didn’t seem particularly shocked either.
“Where is this place?” Itsuki asked as he looked around at the rather wild-looking townscape.
The majority of the people passing by were demi-humans and beastmen. Among the locations I had previously registered with Portal Spear, this was definitely the safest place, far away from Melromarc.
“I recognize this place!” Éclair exclaimed.
Oh? Has she been here before?
Or perhaps she came across documents about this place due to her family’s connections?
“This is Siltvelt.”
“The country of demi-humans, huh? Naofumi should be fine, but what about us?”
“Aren’t we basically in enemy territory now?”
“No need to worry. If we just pretend to be ordinary… human adventurers, we should be fine.”
“So this country isn’t too bad in terms of discrimination?”
“No, Siltvelt is a demi-human supremacist nation. Just being human here means getting suspicious looks everywhere. In the worst case, we could even be enslaved.”
“Sounds like a dangerous place if we attract the wrong kind of attention.”
“That being said, staying near Melromarc, where the assassins from the Three Heroes Church might be lurking, is also dangerous.”
Father and the others had expressions that showed they were struggling to make a decision. Well, as long as we don’t get caught up in any major commotions, it should be fine.
“Now then, Éclair. Whether you still think this is a dream is up to you, but even if it is, I need your help.”
Éclair still seemed a bit dissatisfied, but after some hesitation, she nodded reluctantly.
“…Alright. So what do you want me to do? Even if this is a dream, I intend to report this incident to the Queen.”
“That’s why we plan to head to Faubrey, where the Queen is likely holding a meeting.”

Father had mentioned this before. Keeping an eye out for Takt and avoiding trouble was an option, but if we played our cards right, we wouldn’t have to worry. With support from Faubrey, the largest nation in the world, our movements would become much easier. It would also help in our search for Filo-tan. As expected of Father.
“…I see. Considering the Four Holy Heroes are treasures of the world, it makes sense that Faubrey—the country that should have originally summoned them—would be the right place to take them.”
“Wasn’t this supposed to be some kind of cheating move? Right, Motoyasu?”
“So I’ve heard. I remember hearing something about that in the first world.”
“Then that country must hold some serious resentment over it. It’s surprising this hasn’t led to a war.”
Ren voiced his doubts.
Heh… indeed. That kind of reasoning is easy to counter with any number of explanations.
“With this incident, the Three Heroes Church will surely collapse.”
“Collapse? The church doesn’t even exist anymore…”
“Even if the church is gone, the faith remains.”
“That… sounds like an impressive line, but isn’t that just a huge problem?”
“Isn’t that also the case for the entire country?”
“I’m sure things will work out somehow.”
The Queen will probably handle things skillfully. She is Fiancée’s mother, after all—I have high expectations for her.
“You’re right. Honestly, rather than relying on Motoyasu to protect me, I’d rather be strong enough to defend myself.”
“Yeah, if we just get dragged along helplessly, we might end up caught in another conspiracy.”
“That’s true. I want to get stronger too.”
“Hmm… Fine. So, we just need to fight monsters along the way to make sure the Heroes can battle properly, right?”
“Oh? Éclair, do you not know about the repelling effect of the Four Holy Weapons?”
Well, considering she was locked up in a cell, it’s possible there are some things she doesn’t know.
“The weapons of the Heroes repel each other, so we don’t gain any experience points when fighting together.”
“That’s right. By the way, yesterday when I was hunting, I didn’t gain any experience points. Ren, Motoyasu, Naofumi—were any of you nearby?”
“You mentioned that last night too. I ignored it since Motoyasu interrupted.”
“Yesterday? Yesterday, I was out on the plains outside the castle town, fighting Orange Balloons with that princess, so it wasn’t me.”
“I was fighting monsters near a village two stops ahead until late at night, so I wouldn’t know.”
“The culprit is me!”
I declared it proudly. Itsuki put a hand to his forehead, looking exasperated.
“…I knew it. I had a feeling it was you. No matter how much I searched, I couldn’t find anyone nearby, and you were using concealment skills and magic.”
“Itsuki, you sometimes don’t tell the whole truth. Just in case, I decided to stalk you.”
“I don’t know how my future self became so twisted, but at least my current self doesn’t lie.”

I could have responded to that, but for the sake of maintaining good relations, I decided to keep quiet. After all, he did stay at the inn he said he would. But if Itsuki had lied back there, he’d probably be dancing like a clown for that Crimson Swine princess by now.
“How are we going to level up? Itsuki and I can fight, so that’s fine, but should we have Éclair help raise Naofumi’s level?”
“That seems like the best option. The only problem is that Éclair doesn’t have any equipment.”
“Will Melromarc’s silver and copper coins work here?”
“We can exchange them at a currency exchange, but the rates probably won’t be great.”
“Then, should I head to Melromarc’s castle later and loot what I can? That would be the cheapest option.”

If I search through the castle’s treasury and storerooms, I should be able to find some decent gear. It would definitely be better than the weapons and armor found around here. Plus, Éclair is a knight of Melromarc—she should be comfortable using them.
“S-shouldn’t we stop him?”
“Yeah, Kitamura-dono, please don’t do that.”
“Why not? I don’t see any issue with it.”
“I mean, in RPGs and console games, I guess it’s understandable, but still…”
Father and Itsuki nodded in agreement.
Is that how it is?
“In the second-to-last loop, I just took the equipment from the soldiers I defeated.”
I should’ve done that this time too. The moment I said that, Ren, Itsuki, and Father all went pale and covered their mouths.
“Ugh…”
“J-just stop, please.”
What’s wrong?
“Well, if Father says so, then I have no choice. In that case, it would be best to pool our money, exchange it, and then buy equipment.”
“That sounds reasonable.”
“However! I want to buy a Filolial egg.”
“Right now? When we’re trying to coordinate everything? Filolials… those are the birds that pull carriages, right?”
Father let out a sigh of exasperation.
